messages:
ana: FYI — our IdP partner just disclosed a SAML assertion replay issue that can allow short-lived replayed assertions in legacy session-index flows. They flagged affected integrations and recommended immediate mitigations.

maria (IDP): saw this. affects apps using our old SAML binding (session-index present). Admin-console, identity-proxy, and a small subset of internal tools are on the legacy flow.

ana: tagging @jeff and @sam — we need a mitigation plan in the next 60m. Priority: block replay, protect admin-console, and rotate SSO app secrets if needed.

jeff: can we quick-configure the IdP to require InResponseTo/nonce validation? if so we should flip that globally for our apps.

maria (IDP): yes — IdP sent a recommended toggle: "enforce_authn_request_nonce" = true. It stops replay for new requests. Deployment path: toggle in Okta console -> app settings -> Advanced -> toggle. Will take ~5m per app but we can bulk apply via SCIM API.

sam: for immediate mitigation I suggest: 1) disable legacy session-index on admin-console 2) add a short-lived session check on identity-proxy 3) add WAF rule to drop repeated POSTs to /sso/acs with identical saml_response within 10s.

ana: agreed. jeff, can you push a WAF rule? sam, can you patch identity-proxy to validate Assertion/Subject/SessionIndex lifetime and reject if older than 5s? maria, please flip the IdP toggle for admin-console and identity-proxy first.

jeff: on it. creating rule now: ModSec rule TEMP_DROP_REPLAY to match repeated Base64 SAML payloads within 10s. deploying to staging then prod (rollout 2 min).

maria (IDP): flipping the toggle for admin-console and identity-proxy now. reporting back when done.

sec-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-18425. Owner: ana. Initial severity: P2 -> will re-evaluate after mitigation.

maria (IDP): toggle applied for admin-console and identity-proxy. bulk via API for remaining internal apps scheduled in 30m.

sam: patched identity-proxy to check Assertion/Subject/SessionIndex age and reject >5s. rolling canary to 10% now.

jeff: WAF rule deployed prod (all regions). rule id: 88a1f. blocked ~12 anomalous POSTs in first 60s.

ana: great. next steps: 1) Maria to bulk-toggle remaining apps (ETA 30m) 2) Sam to complete rollout and monitor errors (ETA 45m) 3) Jeff to keep WAF rule for 24h and provide logs 4) Rotate SSO app secret for any app that shows a match in logs (if we see a suspected compromise).

maria (IDP): bulk toggle started. should finish in ~28m. will post API job ID when done.

sam: can add quick metric to console: saml_replay_detected counter and alert if >0 after mitigations. putting alert at 1 within 2m window.

ana: tagging @oncall: if any elevated signals or login anomalies pop up beyond normal, escalate to sec-pager immediately. Also prepare comms for customer-facing teams if we need to notify partners.

sec-bot: Update: Mitigation progress recorded. Current status: controls applied. Monitoring active. Next update in 30m.

jeff: logs uploaded to locker: sso/replay/1842507890/logs-1.gz (internal link).

ana: thanks team. keep this thread for updates only. if you need to DM, reference INC-2026-18425. Will reconvene in 30m or sooner if alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
